description: This file defines the LocationService class in the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for managing location data including retrieval, search, creation, deletion, and normalization functions related to locations in the HR management context.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: A service class managing location related operations such as retrieval, search, saving, and deleting locations within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getLocationDao
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of LocationDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setLocationDao
methods.description: Sets the LocationDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: getLocationById
methods.description: Fetches a Location entity by its ID.

methods.name: searchLocations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Location entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of locations matching the search filter.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Returns the total number of employees assigned to a specific location.

methods.name: getLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Fetches location IDs for an array of employee numbers.

methods.name: getAccessibleLocationsArray
methods.description: Returns an array of locations accessible to a specific employee, normalizing data for frontend use.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Saves a Location object to the database.

methods.name: deleteLocations
methods.description: Flags locations as deleted based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getLocationsArray
methods.description: Retrieves all locations, normalized for frontend consumption.
